title: Power Automate process mining: Process Intelligence Studio for object-centric models
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, allocation API and capacity-assignment controls are supported. The action rating should be prepare rather than awareness only, because the roadmap describes automatic enablement and the briefing recommends preparing shared analysis templates.

claims.claim: Process Intelligence Studio is a customisable process-analysis workspace in Power Automate Process Mining.
claims.quote: The new process intelligence experience is the next-generation interface for process analysis in Power Automate Process Mining. It delivers a comprehensive, customizable dashboard for exploring process intelligence insights.

claims.claim: The workspace offers tab-based navigation.
claims.quote: The tab bar organizes your analytical views. It's located at the top of the interface.

claims.claim: Tiles or cards can be arranged in flexible grid layouts.
claims.quote: Customizable layouts where you can arrange, resize, and configure cards ... The main canvas displays multiple cards arranged in a grid layout.

claims.claim: Filters apply to all cards and visualisations on the current tab.
claims.quote: Filters apply to all cards and visualizations on the current tab.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap plans full workspace functionality for OCPM as well as traditional case-centric models.
claims.quote: The platform supports both traditional and object-centric process mining methodologies ... Object-centric support: Extends full functionality to OCPM models

claims.claim: In OCPM, one event can relate to several objects such as orders, invoices and payments.
claims.quote: OCPM lets one event belong to multiple objects (and object types), keeping the full context intact.

claims.where: What's changing; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: OCPM models are built by ingesting an object-centric event log stored in Azure Data Lake Gen2 or OneLake.
claims.quote: To access OCPM (object-centric process mining) in Power Automate Process Mining, first create a process model by ingesting the object-centric event log (OCEL). ... store the resulting file in a CSV format in either Azure Data Lake Gen2 or OneLake.

claims.claim: Learn's OCPM preview currently has only the Process overview tab.
claims.quote: In the preview of this feature, only the Process overview tab is available.

claims.claim: Learn's OCPM preview currently has only the Default view.
claims.quote: In the preview of this feature, only the Default view is available.

claims.claim: Learn calls the existing interface the process intelligence experience.
claims.quote: The new process intelligence experience is the next-generation interface for process analysis in Power Automate Process Mining.

claims.claim: Learn names Environment Maker as a role for creating processes.
claims.quote: You need the Environment Maker role to create, share, and contribute to processes.

claims.claim: Event logs can contain order and invoice identifiers.
claims.quote: one or more columns listing the object IDs per object type that the event touched (for example, Order=O2, Invoice=I1).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Access to process mining analytics follows process and environment permissions.
claims.quote: The process mining capability relies on environment security and Microsoft Dataverse security roles and privileges to grant access to its features in Power Automate.

claims.claim: The event-log storage location also has access prerequisites.
claims.quote: all users that have the Owner or Co-Owner role on the process must be attributed: Storage Blob Data Reader or Storage Blob Data Contributor role assigned; Azure Resource Manager Reader role assigned, at minimum.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes process analysis rather than a new autonomous automation capability.
claims.quote: Process Intelligence Studio is a modern, flexible workspace designed for comprehensive process analysis.

claims.claim: Azure Data Lake storage carries storage cost.
claims.quote: To analyze differences in data storage prices, transaction prices, and storage capacity reservation pricing between accounts that have a flat namespace versus a hierarchical namespace, see Azure Data Lake Storage pricing.

claims.claim: OneLake storage carries storage cost.
claims.quote: Storage charges: The per-GB, per-month cost that's highest for hot storage and lowest for cold storage.

claims.claim: Power Automate Premium licences contribute process mining capacity.
claims.quote: Each Power Automate Premium license adds 50 MB of process mining capacity to a tenant-wide capacity pool up to a total of 100 GB.

claims.claim: The Process Mining add-on contributes additional process mining capacity.
claims.quote: The Process Mining add-on is a tenant-wide license that's available for the Power Automate Premium license. It offers: An extra 100 GB of process mining capacity to the capacity pool

claims.claim: Process mining capacity is pooled tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Each Power Automate Premium license adds 50 MB of process mining capacity to a tenant-wide capacity pool up to a total of 100 GB.

claims.claim: Process mining data storage capacity can be allocated per environment.
claims.quote: Allocate and deallocate the currencies for the environment. ... ExternalCurrencyType ... The available currency type that can be allocated to an environment. ... ProcessMiningDataStorage

claims.claim: The Power Platform allocation operation is PATCH https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/allocations?api-version=2024-10-01.
claims.quote: PATCH https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/environments/{environmentId}/allocations?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.claim: The allocation request body uses currencyAllocations containing currencyType and allocated.
claims.quote: currencyAllocations | CurrencyAllocationRequestModelV1[] ... allocated | integer (int32) | Specify the currency count. ... currencyType | ExternalCurrencyType | The available currency type that can be allocated to an environment.

claims.claim: ProcessMiningDataStorage is an allowed currencyType in the allocation API.
claims.quote: ExternalCurrencyType ... The available currency type that can be allocated to an environment. ... ProcessMiningDataStorage

claims.claim: A UI control specifically for allocating process mining capacity is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Process mining capacity allocate environment Power Platform admin center ProcessMiningDataStorage UI; process mining capacity allocate environment admin. Read capacity-add-on and allocate-capacity-addons tutorial: generic UI, no process-mining-specific allocation field.

claims.claim: Who may allocate add-on capacity is controlled in Power Platform admin center at Settings > Power Platform settings > Tenant settings > Add-on capacity assignments > Only specific admins.
claims.quote: In the title bar, select the Settings icon. ... Select Power Platform settings. ... On the Tenant settings page, select Add-on capacity assignments, and then select Only specific admins.

claims.claim: pac admin update-tenant-settings --setting-name disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins --setting-value true restricts capacity allocation by environment administrators.
claims.quote: pac admin update-tenant-settings ... Update tenant settings. ... --setting-name ... Name of the setting to be updated. ... --setting-value ... Value of the setting to be updated.

claims.claim: The preview list-tenantsettings page defines disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins as a Boolean setting.
claims.quote: This is a preview feature. ... disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins | Boolean | Ability to disable capacity allocation by environment administrators. Default value is false.

claims.claim: At the time of writing, the Set-TenantSettings reference does not document a PowerShell call for this capacity-allocation setting.
claims.quote: Searched: disableCapacityAllocationByEnvironmentAdmins Set-TenantSettings PowerShell. Read the complete Set-TenantSettings reference: RequestBody, ApiVersion and a WalkMeOptOut example; no named capacity-allocation property or example.

claims.claim: No environment switch for Process Intelligence Studio or OCPM models is documented on either UI or API.
claims.quote: Searched: Process Intelligence Studio disable; object-centric switch Power Automate; Process Intelligence Studio admin settings switch API table. Read studio-overview, OCPM ingestion, list-tenantsettings and search excerpts for PM Process User Settings; none documents that switch.

claims.claim: The allocation programmability tutorial shows allocating add-ons through a flow.
claims.quote: Allocate an add-on using Power Automate flows or Logic Apps ... Add a new action to the canvas, searching for "Allocate and deallocate the currencies for the environment". Set the parameters to higher numeric values to perform assignment.

claims.claim: No licensing change is stated for this roadmap extension.
claims.quote: Searched: object-centric licensing Power Automate; Process Intelligence Studio licensing. Read the roadmap description, process-advisor-overview, studio-overview and OCPM ingestion and overview pages; no licence change for the extension stated.

claims.where: front matter: action; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: An action rating of none fits this automatically enabled workspace change.
claims.quote: action: "none"; "The roadmap says it is enabled automatically for admins, makers and marketers"; "Create shared templates for common analyses, and name an owner for each template that teams will share."
claims.fix: Set action to prepare: the roadmap says enablement is automatic, and the briefing recommends decisions about shared templates and ownership before users adopt the changed workspace.

controlChecks.governs: Process mining capacity allocated to an environment
